0022600119.text: The Wizards (1-1, 3rd in the Southeast, 1 game back, 6th in the East) visit the Charlotte Hornets (2-1, 2nd in the Southeast, 0.5 games back, 5th in the East), with Washington on a one-game losing streak. Washington is missing AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip pinched nerve), while Charlotte is without Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee surgery). The teams haven't met yet in 2026-27, but the Wizards lost all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 129-112 in Washington on February 22, 2026.
